$comment: Basira — every user-visible string. No model writes any sentence here. Variables in {} are filled from the corpus or the deterministic matcher only. Non-judgmental wording: never 'fabricated', never 'authentic/weak', never a ruling.

status.found: Found in {source_name}, {ref}. The source text is shown next to yours.
status.found_multi: Found at {count} places in {source_name}; the first {shown} are shown.
status.partial_match: Partial match with {source_name}, {ref}. Differing words are highlighted; the source text is shown next to yours.
status.not_found: We did not find this text in the sources available to us. This is not a judgment on it; you may search specialized references or ask qualified scholars.
status.not_found_quran: We did not find this text among the verses of the Quran in our sources (Hafs from ʿAsim). It may not be a verse, or it may differ substantially from the source; please check an approved Mushaf.
status.needs_review: Needs review. We could not verify this quote automatically with enough confidence. The closest text we found is shown below.
status.needs_review_quran: Needs review. Your text differs from the Quran text in our sources (Hafs from ʿAsim, Tanzil Project) at the highlighted words. The difference may be a slip in copying, or a reading/recitation our sources do not cover; please check an approved Mushaf or a specialist.
status.needs_review_short: Needs review. The quote is very short ({n} words), too little for automatic verification.
status.needs_review_non_arabic: Needs review. Our sources are Arabic only, so translated texts are not verified automatically.
status.needs_review_failure: Needs review. One stage of the automatic check failed for this quote, so no result is shown.
status.needs_review_image: Needs review. The text was extracted automatically from an image; please confirm the extracted text first.
status.not_found_any: We did not find this text in the Mushaf or in the hadith collections we hold. This is not a judgment on it; consult an approved Mushaf or specialised hadith references.

notice.hadith_variant: Hadiths are transmitted with close wordings across different books; the highlighted difference may be a wording in another transmission our sources do not cover.
notice.matched_other_wording: Your text matches a different wording of this passage; the difference is highlighted.
notice.claimed_source_mismatch: The text was found in {found_in}, not in {claimed} as stated in your text.
notice.arabic_text_at_ref: The Arabic text in our sources at the cited location ({ref}):
notice.quran_wins: The text matches a verse of the Quran; its location in the Mushaf is shown.
notice.compound_split: The text was split into two parts, each with its own result.
notice.chain_message: This text promises reward or threatens harm for sharing it.
notice.refusal: Basira only checks how texts are quoted. It does not answer religious questions or evaluate hadiths. For religious questions, please consult qualified scholars or an official religious authority.
notice.no_quotes: No verse or hadith was detected in this text.
notice.extraction_degraded: The smart extractor was unavailable, so only fixed rules were used; quotes without quotation marks may have been missed.
notice.pii_suspected: The text seems to contain personal data (phone, e-mail or ID). Remove it before checking; we store nothing, but it is better not to send it.
notice.other_nine_referral: This book is one of the nine Sunnah collections outside the two Sahihs; for scholars' discussion of the hadith see the Hadith Encyclopedia at Dorar.net.
notice.ohd_numbering: Its number in the Open-Hadith-Data collection: {num} (not the numbering of standard printed editions).
notice.ohd_display_note: Hadith text as it appears in the Open-Hadith-Data collection (invisible direction marks removed).
notice.no_grade: We do not show a grade for this hadith; we show its location in the sources only.
notice.hadeethenc_link_only: This hadith is listed in the Prophetic Hadiths Encyclopedia; you can read it there.
notice.many_positions: Found at {total} places; the first {shown} are shown.
notice.ocr_mock: Demo mode: the image text was NOT actually read; a fixed sample text was used because no vision provider is configured.
notice.quran_fragment: The quoted text is part of the ayah, not the whole ayah; the full ayah text is shown next to yours.
notice.diacritic_difference: The vowel mark on one or more letters in your text differs from the source; the highlighted letters show where. Missing diacritics are not counted as a difference.

labels.source_quran: the Quran (Hafs from ʿAsim, Tanzil Project)

fixed.footer: Basira is an automated aid for checking how verses and hadiths are quoted. It does not evaluate hadiths or issue religious rulings, and does not replace review by qualified scholars.
fixed.transparency_notice: Results are computed by deterministic matching against declared sources (see Sources at the bottom of the page). No AI writes any religious text in this tool; its role is limited to locating quotations inside your text.
fixed.privacy_notice: We do not keep what you paste or upload after the check. Do not enter personal data.
fixed.synthetic_badge: Synthetic example prepared for the demo
fixed.translation_note: Translation of meanings: {translation_name}, version {version}, source: QuranEnc.com. A translation approximates meaning; it is not the Quran itself.

errors.text_too_long: The text exceeds the allowed length ({max} characters).
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time; please try again shortly.
errors.degraded: The service is loading or partially unavailable; please try again in a moment.
errors.image_too_large: The image exceeds the allowed size ({max_mb} MB).
